name: Rime-Bound Gloom
body:
Rime-Bound Gloom *
Source Blood of Shadows pg. 19
The gloom creates an area of freezing shadow in its splash radius that deals 2d6 points of cold damage to all creatures in the area each turn. This effect lasts 1 round for every 2 alchemist levels. An alchemist must be at least 6th level to select this discovery.
